THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Rൾඏඈർൺඍංඈඇ ඈඋൽൾඋ ඎඇൽൾඋ Sൾർඍංඈඇ 39(1)

THE allotment of land speciﬁ ed morefully in the Order No. 299 of 2013 dated 30.09.2013 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1830/51 dated 04.10.2013 was vested in the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. The possession of the land depicted below has not yet been taken for and on behalf of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Therefore, I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, by virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 39(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, do hereby revoke the Order made in respect of the land speciﬁ ed in the Schedule of the Order No. 299 of 2013 dated 30.09.2013 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1830/51 dated 04.10.2013. K.D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.

My No.: 4-3/10/2012/LRB/115. Land Acquiring Oﬃ cer's No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/ MH/05.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Land Secretariat,No. 1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla,09th April, 2025.
